name: Eco-Friendly Cabin Retreat
description: A sustainable and charming cabin designed for minimal environmental impact. Features reclaimed wood accents, highly-efficient insulation, and a rooftop solar array. Perfect for nature lovers seeking a modern, off-grid lifestyle.
planDetails:
2 Bedrooms, 1 full bathroom
Open-concept living room with a fireplace
Compact, high-efficiency kitchen
Large covered front porch
Rainwater harvesting system
Rooftop deck access

buildingCostEstimates.description: Standard sustainable materials and local craftsmanship, focusing on core functionality.
Premium, imported sustainable materials, geothermal heating/cooling, and high-end fixtures.

architecturalDesign.description: Comprehensive architectural plans for the Eco-Friendly Cabin Retreat.
architecturalDesign.overview: Includes detailed floor plans, elevations, cross-sections, and material specifications for a green build.

structuralDesign.description: Detailed structural engineering drawings focusing on timber framing and foundation.
structuralDesign.overview: Covers all structural elements for a stable and durable cabin structure in various climates.

billOfQuantities.description: A complete bill of quantities for costing and procurement of eco-friendly materials.
billOfQuantities.overview: Provides an itemized list of all materials, parts, and labor, with a focus on sustainable sourcing.
